description: Load a Playwright run that happened elsewhere (a CI job's JSON report, or a folder of blob reports from shards) so get-failure, suggest-fix and diagnose-flaky work on it like a local run. CI paths are mapped onto this checkout and traces are found in the unpacked test-results artifact; the run is recorded in the history with its commit.

commit.description: Commit the run tested (default: read from the report metadata)

record.description: Add the run to the local history for analyze-history (default true)

report.description: Playwright JSON report inside the project (e.g. ci-artifacts/results.json), or a folder of blob reports (*.zip) from sharded jobs

traceDirs.description: Folders inside the project where the job's test-results artifact was unpacked (default: the report's folder and its parent)

name: load-report
title: Load a CI report
